description: Generate AI-written legal compliance documents (privacy policy, terms of service, cookie policy, etc.) for a previously scanned site. Requires a scanId from a prior URL scan and a PAGEGUARD_API_KEY with available credits. Document types: 'single' ($29 — privacy + terms + cookie), 'bundle' ($49 — everything), 'addon_security' ($19), 'addon_a11y' ($19), 'addon_schema' ($19), 'app_bundle' ($39), 'submission_guide' ($19).

documentType.description: Product type to generate. One of: single, bundle, addon_security, addon_a11y, addon_schema, app_bundle, submission_guide. Defaults to 'bundle'.

scanId.description: The scan ID from a previous pageguard_scan_url result

name: pageguard_generate_docs
